facts.text: Atlus's and developer Racdym's first 3D fighter. It reached Japanese arcades in December 1996 and never left Japan.
Its working title was Ultimate Domain, and it was first meant for Sega's Model 2 board.
It runs on Sony's ZN-1, PlayStation-based arcade hardware. That's why MAME needs the Atlus ZN-1 BIOS, coh1001l.zip.
Angels versus demons, fought under low ceilings: the touches that set it apart from other 3D fighters of its day.
Directed by Hideki Yayama and Takeshi Murata. Racdym later became Racjin.
Landing or taking hits fills your Sol or Lunar gauge. When it's full, press Block + Kick + Punch to power up.
Powered up? Down, then Down + Block + Kick + Punch unleashes an all-out assault.
Each attack changes with how quickly you press its button. Block + Punch is a throw.
The PlayStation port hides extra fighters, including Kurara from Atlus's own Power Instinct.
